kind: independent point-response calculation motivated by Droste1996 Fig7; not experimental data or authors FORTRAN replay
initial_density: diagonal finite Gaussian p(M0) proportional exp(-M0^2/(2*sigma^2))
angle_unit: degree externally, radian in Wigner functions
dco_chosen_convention: R*=W00(gamma1 theta0,gamma2 theta90)/W00(gamma1 theta90,gamma2 theta0); not yet independently mapped to Ref1 Kramer1989 definition

pdco_geometry.note: use physical opposite directions; sourceFig7 phi0 maps to180 by stated thetaPOL90 symmetry, to be checked numerically

first_gamma_candidates: M1+E2,5 to4,parity-conserving hypothesis; define delta_a=a(E2)/a(M1) in this implementation
d_convention: exp(-i theta Jy), d^1_(0,+1)=+sin(theta)/sqrt2; CG Condon-Shortley
linear_analyzer_amplitude: (-exp(i*psi)*A_plus + exp(-i*psi)*A_minus)/sqrt2; psi0 is electric field in emission plane
normalization: individual multipole channel integrates to identity after angular/helicity sum; normalized mixed amplitudes when comparing probabilities
source_amplitude_note: D96Eq5 has i^(L+delta_TM); M1 andE2 both i^2. Exact inter-source delta symbol/phase mapping remains pending original KS70. Numeric resemblance alone will not establish it.

source_printed_model_benchmarks.scope: author calculation, no quoted counting/fit covariance; rounded values, not measured points

boundaries: point detectors, no finite acceptance/FEP/polarimeter Q/background
no unobserved intervening transitions, sidefeeding or external deorientation
same chosen initial population for competing hypotheses
delta_a has no claimed KS70 or D96 symbol identity until exact operator/order comparison
conditional identifiability witness only; no measured RDCO or uncertainty invented
